_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A short mobile commit message shows its links after the body without an expand control, and its metadata Comment action quotes the whole message. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. The ".diff-commit-message-body" contains "Short body note". There is no "Show more" button in ".diff-commit-message". The ".diff-commit-message-links" contains "Open on GitHub" and "Open raw commit"; verify with eval expecting true that the body precedes the links in document order. Click the "Comment" button in ".diff-commit-message-mobile-meta". The comment dialog's selected text contains both "Short mobile message" and "Short body note". Fill its input with "Whole message feedback" and click "Add Comment". The [data-testid="message-input"] value contains "> Short mobile message", "> Short body note", and "Whole message feedback".

steps.expression: (() => { const body = document.querySelector('.diff-commit-message-body'); const links = document.querySelector('.diff-commit-message-links'); if (!body || !links) return false; return !!(body.compareDocumentPosition(links) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING); })()
